intro: A gigantic horn that came from Margol the Rager in Searing Gorge is scratched and cracked, with a broken axe head lodged in its rough surface. The axe head is etched as the property of Mountaineer Pebblebitty, and it shatters into a million pieces when you try to dislodge it. The horn is to be taken to Pebblebitty.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The gigantic horn has numerous scratches and cracks. An unusual metal object is lodged into the rough surface.
Upon further examination, you notice that the metal is actually a broken axe head. On the metal, the following words are etched:
When you try and dislodge the broken axe head, it shatters into a million pieces.

paras: What have you got there? A fake obviously!

I've been face to face with Margol and I know for a fact that her horn is at least eight times larger than the one you've got in your hands, friend. You probably got that off of a stormsnout in the Barrens. No friend, you can't fool Pebblebitty!
